title: Coding-OS Project Preset
description: Schema for templates/_presets/<id>.yaml. A preset is a named stack composition the user can pick at init instead of listing stacks by hand (docs/engineering/config-composition.md § Presets, TASK-356). Distinct from thinking_os role-chain presets.

id.description: Lowercase identifier. Must match the filename stem under templates/_presets/.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in discovery (CLI list, hub, wizard).

description.description: One-to-three sentences on what this composition is for.

stacks.description: Stack ids to install, in order. Each must exist in templates/<id>/stack.yaml; an unknown id skips the preset with a WARN.

skills.description: Extra skills beyond what the stacks declare. Stored in .coding-os.yaml; linking is TASK-370.

modules.description: Subsystem toggles (docs, tasks, …). Stored in .coding-os.yaml; toggle behavior is TASK-349.

notes.description: Authoring caveats; not shown in discovery.
